# Next Elite - An open source production-ready Next.js starter kit

> A production-ready, frontend-first Next.js 16 + React 19 + TypeScript starter kit with a complete authentication flow (email/password against your own backend API), a protected dashboard, a reusable shadcn/ui component kit, next-intl i18n (English + Hindi), Oxlint/Oxfmt tooling, and a polished developer experience. API-first with no bundled database.

---

## 1. Project Metadata & SEO Tags

- **Project Name**: Next Elite (SaaS Boilerplate, Starter Kit, Template)
- **Framework Stack**: Next.js 16 (App Router), React 19, TypeScript, Node.js 22.12+
- **UI & CSS**: Tailwind CSS v4, shadcn/ui, Radix UI, CVA components, light/dark theme
- **Authentication**: API-driven email/password (no social/OAuth providers)
- **i18n**: next-intl, cookie-based, English + Hindi
- **Performance**: Optimized for Lighthouse (Performance, Accessibility, Best Practices, SEO)
- **Primary Category**: Developer Templates / SaaS Starters / Next.js Boilerplates
- **Keywords**: Next.js 16, React 19, API authentication, RBAC, next-intl, type-safe i18n, API-first, sitemap, robots, llms.txt, T3 Env, Vitest, Playwright, Oxlint, Oxfmt, Lefthook, Knip, Tailwind v4, SaaS starter, frontend-first boilerplate, zero-database starter, auth starter

---

## 3. Key Architectural Pillars

### A. API-First & Database-Free
Connects to any existing backend (REST, GraphQL, or BFF). No local database required. It authenticates against your backend `POST /api/v1/auth/login` endpoint, stores the returned token in an httpOnly cookie, resolves identity on the server, and the client caches live data with TanStack Query.

```
[User] -> [Server Component] -> [getCurrentUser() from session cookie]
              |
              +-> Server HTML (next-intl messages from messages/)
              |
              +-> [Client] -> [TanStack Query] -> [Your Backend API]
```

### B. Feature-Based Structure
Vertical slices under `src/features/`:
- `auth/` - API login client, session/server helpers, RBAC model, login form, Zod schemas
- `i18n/` - next-intl config, RTL helper, language switcher
- `site/` - `site.config.json`, SEO helpers, locale utilities

Shared UI lives in `src/components/shared/` and `src/components/ui/`.

---

## 4. Feature Specifications

### Authentication & RBAC
- **Login**: email/password against the backend `POST /api/v1/auth/login`; the returned access token is stored in an httpOnly session cookie
- **Roles**: `admin` and `user`, derived from the backend role strings (any role containing `ADMIN` maps to `admin`)
- **Identity**: `getCurrentUser()` (server-only, request-cached) reads the session cookie and returns the user
- **Guards**: `/dashboard` requires a session; server pages redirect to `/` when signed out
- **RBAC model**: `hasPermission()` plus `ROLE_PERMISSIONS` power the dashboard

### Type-Safe i18n (next-intl)
- **Two locales**: English (`en`, default) and Hindi (`hi`)
- **Cookie locale**: `NEXT_LOCALE` cookie, no `/en` URL prefixes
- **Compile-time keys**: Invalid `t("key")` calls fail the TypeScript build

### SEO, PWA & Agentic Browsing
- **Single config**: `src/features/site/site.config.json` drives metadata, sitemap, and manifest
- **Routes**: `sitemap.ts`, `robots.ts`, `manifest.ts`
- **Rich previews**: Open Graph, Twitter cards, JSON-LD structured data
- **llms.txt**: This file at `/llms.txt` for AI discovery

### Forms & Validation
- **Zod** schemas for login and password reset
- **React Hook Form** with `zodResolver`
- **InputError** for accessible inline field errors

### Testing & Quality Gates
- **Vitest** + React Testing Library; `renderWithProviders` helper in `tests/utils/render.tsx`
- **Playwright** E2E in `e2e/`; CI uses production server (Chromium)
- **Oxlint + Oxfmt** for lint and format; **Knip** for unused code/deps
- **Lefthook** pre-commit (oxlint + oxfmt); **Commitlint** on commit messages
- **`npm run check`**: typecheck, lint, knip, and unit tests in one command

### Observability
- **Sentry** on client and server
- **`GET /api/health`** for load balancers and Docker health checks

---

## 5. Quick Start & Setup

### Requirements
- Node.js 22.12+
- npm

### Local Installation
```bash
git clone https://github.com/salmanshahriar/Next-Elite.git
cd Next-Elite
npm install
cp .env.example .env
npm run dev
```

Open `http://localhost:6767` (default dev port). The root `/` is the login screen.

### Docker
```bash
docker compose up --build
# or
docker build -t next-elite .
docker run --rm --env-file .env -p 6767:6767 next-elite
```

---

## 6. Scripts & CI

| Script | Purpose |
|--------|---------|
| `npm run dev` | Dev server (port 6767) |
| `npm run build` | Production build (standalone output) |
| `npm run start` | Production server (port 6767) |
| `npm run check` | typecheck + lint + knip + test |
| `npm run lint` / `lint:fix` | Oxlint + Oxfmt |
| `npm run test` | Vitest unit/component tests |
| `npm run e2e` | Playwright end-to-end tests |
| `npm run playwright:install` | Install Playwright browsers |

**CI workflows** (`.github/workflows/`): `check.yml` on push/PR; `playwright.yml` for E2E.

---

## 7. Routes

- `/` - Login screen (redirects authenticated users to `/dashboard`)
- `/dashboard` - Protected signed-in dashboard (redirects anonymous users to `/`)
- `/password-reset` - Request a password reset, with a back control
- `/api/auth/login` - Proxies credentials to the backend login endpoint and sets the session cookie
- `/api/auth/logout` - Clears the session cookie
- `/api/health` - Health probe

> This is an authentication-only app: there is no marketing site or component showcase route.

---

## 8. Intended Use Cases

- **Best for**: Auth-first apps, SaaS frontends that consume external APIs, multilingual apps (the RTL plumbing is retained)
- **Not ideal for**: Simple brochure sites or apps that need a bundled ORM/database layer
